title: The Winter Harbor
author: Marguerite Nakamura
blurb: Lior Villalobos, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
